gloss: headnote; note printed at the top of a page

definitions.gloss: headnote; note printed in the top margin
definitions.explanation: An annotation placed in the top margin of a page, above the main text. Common in annotated editions of classical or scholarly works, where it comments on the passage below it.

examples.japanese: {頭注|とうちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頭注|とうちゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧。

⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{注釈書|ちゅうしゃくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{頭注|とうちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{語句|ごく}→語句：02840_goku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: In annotated editions of the classics, explanations of words and phrases appear in the headnotes.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧ (head, top) + ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (note, annotation). Literally "a note at the top (of the page)."

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{脚注|きゃくちゅう}→脚注：06423_kyakuchuu⟧: footnote — a note at the foot of the page
- ⟦{傍注|ぼうちゅう}→傍注：29710_bouchuu⟧: marginal note — a note in the side margin
- ⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧: annotation, commentary — the general term
